title: a-proof-run-by-hand-outside-cairn-test-runs-under-the-seal
intention: A CC tool call that runs a proof by python path runs under the tester's instance seal instead, rewritten at PreToolUse; one that runs pytest is refused with the `cairn test` line.
why: A CC session running a proof by hand (python3 <proof>, pytest <proof>) runs it outside the tester's instance seal, against live ~/.cairn. Measured 2026-10-06: 88 of 290 proofs write live state that way (2705 paths: dated emissions, inference tickets, tester run files, appends to bus.log and last_known), and this session's own first e9a2 run leaked 6 inference tickets. The lived symptom: the operator's live logs and trouble lanes fill with fixture records nobody can tell from real ones, and one proof overwrote the live superclaude loop.pid. 313 files of standing advice say `python3 <proof>`; a refuse-then-retype gate would leave all of them contradicting it and cost a turn per follower, so the python3 hand is rewritten under the seal instead (peer akiendelllinux_cc_0, 2026-10-06). Parent: dda0e72b9c67.
traces_to: Law 4 (a rule that matters is enforced by physics): 'run proofs via cairn test' is a sentence in memory and the e9a2 leak shows it failing; Law 8 (a proof's run must not damage the world it measures); Law 5 (the 313 advice lines stay true in effect). Parent dda0e72b9c67.
how: New bin/cmd/proofgate, shaped like bin/cmd/deletegate (stdin JSON {tool_name, tool_input.command}). When the command TEXT runs pytest in any spelling (pytest, py.test, python -m pytest): exit 2, stderr naming `bin/cairn test <proof>`. Else when it runs a file under a proofs/ directory by python (incl. env/timeout/strace prefixes, cd then a relative path, the module form, a loop running a variable over a proofs/ glob): exit 0 with hookSpecificOutput {hookEventName: PreToolUse, permissionDecision: allow, permissionDecisionReason and additionalContext saying it was rewritten, updatedInput: {command: '<repo>/bin/cairn test --exec ' + shlex.quote(original)}} (Claude Code hooks docs, code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks, read 2026-10-06). Else exit 0 silent: cairn test itself, reads of proofs, other python. Registered in .claude/settings.json PreToolUse matcher Bash beside deletegate. Depends on 2c9eeab2da87 (cairn test --exec). Proof bin/proofs/test_proof_gate.py, written red.
falsifier: Done when (1) python3-by-path spellings (`python3 cairn/devices/x/proofs/test_y.py`, `cd cairn && python3 devices/x/proofs/test_y.py`, env/timeout/strace prefixes, the module form, a loop over a proofs/ glob) exit 0 with permissionDecision allow and updatedInput.command == `<repo>/bin/cairn test --exec ` + shlex.quote(original), and a note that the command was rewritten; (2) `pytest cairn/tools/base/proofs/` and `python3 -m pytest -q x.py` exit 2 with a stderr carrying `cairn test`; (3) `bin/cairn test --seal cairn/devices/x/proofs/test_y.py`, `cat cairn/devices/x/proofs/test_y.py` and `python3 -c 'print(1)'` exit 0 with no output; (4) .claude/settings.json registers it under PreToolUse matcher Bash; (5) every per-proof command the census harness ran, rebuilt for every proof on disk, is refused (pytest) or rewritten (python3), never passed bare; (6) a rewritten fixture proof run end to end prints CAIRN_TESTER_INSTANCE_SEALED=1; (7) a rewritten command carrying single quotes, double quotes and a pipe runs end to end under the seal with the same stdout as the bare command it replaced. WRONG INTENT if a legitimate CC workflow measured in the corpus needs a raw proof run that the seal cannot serve. Scripts that run proofs from a file pass unseen: census 2026-10-06 measured 0 such executors besides codemother's verdict (68cef2ddd8ef), recorded at BUILDME.
watchme: none, because the gate (shaped like bin/cmd/deletegate, registered in .claude/settings.json) tells the session of every rewrite and refusal; its proof bin/proofs/test_proof_gate.py reds on drift via component_color
children: none, because the gate is one file plus one registration line
